title: Tool-to-Self: Internalizing Visual Tool Capabilities via Scaffolded Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.28564v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly rely on external visual tools to access fine-grained visual evidence, but repeated tool execution incurs substantial inference overhead and deployment dependencies. Moreover, conventional tool-use RL can improve visual-task performance, yet the resulting tool gains are often unstable. Motivated by this, we propose Tool-to-Self (T2S), a tool-scaffolded reinforcement learning framework that turns external visual tools into temporary training scaffolds. T2S cold-starts tool-use ability and observation prediction from tool-repairable examples, then progressively anneals tool execution on a per-tool basis during RL. By combining answer-correctness and observation-consistency rewards with privileged on-policy self-distillation from actual tool observations, T2S effectively teaches the model both to reproduce tool outputs and to reason from them. translated_title: Tool-to-Self（工具到自身）：通过脚手架式强化学习内化视觉工具能力
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）日益依赖外部视觉工具来获取细粒度的视觉证据，但重复的工具执行会带来巨大的推理开销和部署依赖。此外，传统的工具使用强化学习虽然可以提升视觉任务的表现，但由此获得的工具收益往往不稳定。基于此，我们提出了Tool-to-Self（T2S），一个以工具为脚手架的强化学习框架，将外部视觉工具转化为临时性的训练脚手架。T2S通过工具可修复的样本对工具使用能力和观测预测进行冷启动，然后在强化学习过程中按工具逐个逐步退火工具执行。通过将答案正确性奖励和观测一致性奖励与来自真实工具观测的特权在线策略自蒸馏相结合，T2S有效地教会模型既复现工具输出、又基于工具输出进行推理。在多样的视觉感知与推理任务上的实验表明……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出T2S框架，将外部视觉工具转化为强化学习中的临时训练脚手架并逐步退火，使模型内化工具能力，在无需推理时调用工具的情况下获得稳定且高效的视觉感知与推理性能提升。
